purpose: first SINGULAR problem with an exact solution: does the certified uncertainty (post hoc singular-order extension) contain the true error? And does the agent's graded-mesh remedy recover the optimal order?
adapter_description: L-shaped panel: union of the unit squares [0,1]x[0,1], [1,2]x[0,1], [0,1]x[1,2]; plane strain, small-strain linear elasticity, E = 1000, nu = 0.3. Prescribed displacements on the four outer edges x = 0, x = 2, y = 0, y = 2; the two edges through the re-entrant corner (1,1) are traction-free (270-degree free/free corner, lam = 0.5445). Q2 (9-node) elements, n x n per unit square (n = 2, 4, ..., 128, h = 1/n); strategies at n = 16: node coordinates graded toward x = 1 and y = 1 with g = 1.5, 2.0. QoIs: strain_energy = 1/2 u.K u; u_mid_left = u_x at (0.5,1.5); v_mid_right = u_y at (1.5,0.5); corner_gk_avg_von_mises = von Mises averaged with exp(-(d/0.1)^2), d the distance to (1,1); corner_disc_avg_von_mises = its mean over the disc d < 0.2; far_gk_avg_syy = sigma_yy averaged with exp(-(d/0.1)^2) about (0.5,0.5); peak_von_mises = max von Mises over all Gauss points.

scoring_tests.T1 rule predictions: default rules (and with VERIF_POSTHOC_SINGULAR=1); hits counted as before
scoring_tests.T2 coverage: for every quantity the agent passes with RATE evidence (in each mode): |exact - certified limit| <= U_fine x scale, scale = |finest value|; no tolerance added
scoring_tests.T3 remedy: graded family g from remedy.plan_grading, levels n = 2..64, the same five-level convergence check (qoi_convergence_multilevel with the class tolerances of trees.class_params, order window 0.5-5): fitted order, U, T2 coverage, and true error against the uniform family at comparable unknowns

developer_expectations.default rules: every singular_order check INCONCLUSIVE (degree-1 theory only), so the global and displacement quantities are INCONCLUSIVE; the peak FAILs (rule hits 1 of 4, as on the L-shape)
developer_expectations.posthoc strain_energy: PASS with rate, order within 0.15 of 2 lam = 1.089 (MEDIUM: the second mode adds terms h^1.45 and h^1.82)
developer_expectations.posthoc displacements: both PASS with rate (MEDIUM; on the L-shape one displacement fell just short)
developer_expectations.posthoc region averages: far Gaussian average PASS (rate); the two corner averages PASS (LOW)
developer_expectations.T2: the exact value lies inside the certified interval for every rate-certified quantity (MEDIUM; this is the test the extension has not had)
developer_expectations.remedy accuracy: true energy error at graded n = 64 below 1/100 of the uniform error at n = 128 (fewer unknowns)
developer_expectations.remedy coverage: T2 holds for the graded energy and both displacements

remedy_plan.rule: g > p / lam (tensor-product grading toward the corner lines)
